messages:
mira_partnerships: Quick sync request 1: SI onboarding checklist + mentor certification + marketplace voucher parity. We keep getting edge cases from hardware partners. Can we make a compact playbook this week?

jon_ops: +1. Problems seen: vendors not accepting marketplace tokens, mentors unsure of handoff process, shipping delays for resellers. Need a 1-page playbook + 3 copy-paste Slack snippets.

paloma_enable: I can draft the one-pager: sections: pre-flight (interop script), voucher parity check, mentor shift rota, escalation ladder. Will keep it one side.

kevin_market: I'll export SKU mappings and flag resellers that require tax docs or manual voucher acceptance. I'll add a CSV and a short annex on local flows.

si-badge-bot: Task created: #SI-8401 "Compact SI onboarding playbook" assigned to paloma_enable + kevin_market, due 2024-11-01.

mira_partnerships: For certification: partners ask for a lightweight badge. Proposal: 2 shadow shifts + one 20-min practical (interop script + simple escalation). Badge grants access to voucher pool. Thoughts?

paloma_enable: Agreed. Practical should be proctored and include: run validation script, interpret output, escalate with minimal redacted logs. Badge expires 12 months. I'll add a short rubric.

jon_ops: Pre-flight script idea (tiny): nvidia-smi, uname -r, curl to model asset, check MTU. Keep output to paste in sheet.

kevin_market: I'll include a column in CSV: reseller_accepts_voucher (true/false) and tax_covered_by_voucher (yes/no). That should help mentors know if extra steps are needed.

paloma_enable: Slack snippets I'll add: mentor handoff, partner preflight request, vendor follow-up for reseller flow. Example mentor handoff: 

"Hi team, handing off to @mentor_b. Shift overlap 30m -> 90m co-support. Interop: PASS. Voucher: CLAIM-ABCD redeemed. Escalations: tag @jon_ops."

mira_partnerships: Timeline: can we have drafts by EOD Thu? We have a SI cohort starting next week.

kevin_market: CSV draft by Thu EOD. Will mark high-risk SKUs.

paloma_enable: Playbook + badge rubric by Thu EOD. Will post links in thread.

si-badge-bot: Meeting scheduled: SI onboarding quick review 1 2024-11-03 11:00 UTC. Invite sent.

jon_ops: One more: add a shared sheet with columns: cohort, mentor, badge_status, voucher_code, reseller_flag, interop_passed. Add checkbox 'interop_validated' so mentors can tick after running script.

mira_partnerships: Great. Keep updates here and ping me for legal if vendor invoices needed. End.
